from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the collection: its title and the titles of other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER papers in the provided collection that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
